name: b11858
body:
<details open>

llama : deny -sm tensor for arches with moe amax rescaling (#31081)

The amax POOL_1D reduction spans the whole matmul row, so a device cannot
compute it from an axis-0 split. The Meta split-state case reported
MIRRORED, which gives each device a partial max of its own slice. Drop
that case and deny -sm tensor for the arches which build the amax graph,
see [TAG_MOE_AMAX_SCALE].

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB)

</details>
